description: The run result `ui` keys of a background (docs/timeline-ui.md "どの背景を出すか"). Python writes them (node_runtime.py PREVIEW_UI_KEYS, nodes.py _upstream_ui); web_src/pano_background_choice.js BACKGROUND_UI_KEYS reads them. tests/test_background_ui_keys_parity.py and tests/pano_background_choice.test.mjs both check against this table.
